doors.name: Wikimedia Commons — Audio files of 1924
doors.note: 38 currently indexed files; includes Joyce, Coolidge, Piłsudski, Norman Clapham, several Sun Yat-sen speeches, and vocal/music recordings.

doors.name: Library of Congress National Jukebox — Clancy's Minstrels
doors.note: Recorded 1924-10-28; category Spoken, genre Comedies; useful pointer into the 1924 spoken-comedy seam.

doors.name: Library of Congress — National Jukebox spoken-word genres
doors.note: Spoken-word taxonomy includes comedies, descriptive specialties, ethnic spoken word, monologues/dialogues/recitations, and speeches.

doors.name: Wikimedia Commons — sound-recording rights
doors.note: As of 2026, published sound recordings from 1925 and earlier are in the U.S. public domain; underlying works still need their own rights check.
